# InstaPay orders in WhatsApp

A customer can order from your catalog on WhatsApp and pay with InstaPay. The order stays **awaiting payment** until your store confirms the money arrived.

## What you need before you start
- Your store on Ebda Store with the **InstaPay** payment method turned on and your InstaPay address (IPA) entered correctly.
- The catalog synced with Ebda Chat.
- A connected number. The **Ordering bot** is on by default; to stop it, open **Bot**, then **Bot switches** ([guide 30](30-bot-switches-and-sending-speed.md)).
- A running package that includes ordering in chat.

## How it works (customer side)
1. The customer picks products from the catalog on WhatsApp and sends the cart.
2. They choose **InstaPay** as the payment method.
3. They type their address or pick a saved one.
4. They receive a message with the **InstaPay address (IPA)**, the **amount** and an order **reference**.
5. They transfer from their bank app and send a **photo of the receipt** in the same chat.

## How it works (your side)
1. The receipt is forwarded to your store once, together with the order.
2. **The order stays "awaiting payment"**; it is not confirmed automatically from the picture.
3. You check the receipt in Ebda Store and confirm the money arrived.
4. When the order is confirmed, the customer is told on WhatsApp (if still inside the 24-hour window).

## Notes
- The customer has **48 hours** to send the receipt after receiving the payment details.
- The amount and reference come from Ebda Store; do not change them by hand.
- A second picture sent later is not forwarded again for the same order.

## Troubleshooting
- **The customer sent the receipt and nothing happened:** check that the picture arrived in the same conversation and that less than 48 hours passed.
- **An item ran out of stock:** the customer gets a message naming the item, and it is removed from the cart.
- **131047:** the window closed (over 24 hours). Send the customer a payment reminder template.
- **Money arrived but the order is still pending:** confirm the payment in Ebda Store.

# The AI agent

The agent replies to your customers in chat in Egyptian Arabic, searches the catalog, reports order status and starts a new order. Whenever a customer asks for a person, it hands over to you.

## What you need before you start
- A connected number and a synced catalog.
- **AI credits.** Your package gives you credits each month; if they run out, buy a credit pack by card in **Wallet > Buy AI credits** (the owner does this; see the wallet guide), wait for next month, or upgrade your package.
- A few lines about your store policies (shipping, returns, opening hours) so the agent can answer accurately.

## Steps
1. Open **AI agent** in the side rail.
2. Turn on **Turn on the AI agent**.
3. In **Reply style** write how it should speak in your own words (for example: friendly and brief). In **Reply language** choose Arabic, English or **Same as the customer**.
4. Choose the **agent tone** (warm, formal or playful).
5. In **Your store Q&A** write your shipping, exchange and payment details and any policy, so the agent answers with them. If it is under about 3,000 characters the agent reads all of it on every reply; if it is longer, the agent searches it, and the screen warns you until it is ready for search.
6. To get a WhatsApp message when a customer needs a team member, enter your number in **Your WhatsApp number for alerts** in international format (for example +201001234567).
7. In **Wh

at the agent may promise** switch on, yourself, anything you allow (refunds, discounts, free delivery, exchanges, guarantee). **Everything is off by default**, and the agent promises none of it unless you switch it on, even if your Q&A mentions it.
8. Set **how long it stays silent after handing over** in minutes (default 120).
9. Choose the **AI engine**: the built-in one (uses your credits) or your own OpenAI-compatible key (stored encrypted and never shown again).
10. Save, then test from your own phone.

Only the store owner can change these settings. Your AI credit balance shows at the top of the screen.

## What the agent knows about your store and the customer
- **Your store:** its name, shipping zones and fees, cash-on-delivery fee, return window, payment methods, opening hours and address, all read from your Ebda Store settings. Anything you did not fill in there, the agent says it will check; it never guesses a figure.
- **Search:** it uses your store's own search (it understands dialect, Franco-Arabic and typos, and meaning such as "a gift for my wife") and respects a budget the customer mentions.
- **A returning customer:** greeted by first name, with their last address remembered and offered as "same address as last time?" in two buttons while ordering. Order status always comes from the live order in Ebda Store, never from memory.
- **Memory:** the last 8 messages in full plus a sh

ort recap of earlier ones in the same chat.
- **Franco-Arabic:** "3ayez fostan a7mar" is understood and answered in Arabic. The agent answers only about your store and politely declines anything else.
- The customer sees the read tick and "typing…" as soon as the agent starts working on a reply.

## Important notes
- The agent replies **only inside the 24-hour window**. Outside it you need a template ([guide 4](04-templates-and-the-24-hour-window.md)).
- Every reply uses AI credits. When credits run out the agent stops and hands the conversation to staff.
- The agent does not change prices or add discounts. Orders, prices and stock come from Ebda Store.

## Voice notes
When a customer sends a **voice note**, the agent listens to it, and the text appears under the voice note in your inbox (marked "Voice note transcript"). It then answers like it would a typed message. Voice notes longer than 2 minutes, or beyond your store's daily limit, get a polite request to type instead. If a voice note could not be understood, the inbox shows **Voice note (not transcribed)**: listen to it and reply yourself.

## Handoff to staff
The conversation is tagged **needs_human** and is highlighted in the inbox. If you set an alert number, you also get a WhatsApp message with the customer's name and their last 3 messages: a normal message if you wrote to the store number in the last 24 hours, otherwise the **handoff_alert** template (install the starter templates and wait for Meta to approve it). If neither is possible no message can be sent and you only see the tag in the inbox. Every morning at 10:00 you also get a message with how many conversations are still waiting. The agent stays silent until the handoff period passes or until a staff member replies. Choose **Take over** at the top of the chat to handle it yourself. When you reply to a customer (from the inbox or the WhatsApp Business app) or ass

ign the chat to a person, the agent also stays silent for the handoff period, even if the chat was never handed over.
Handoff happens when the customer asks for a person, the agent cannot answer, or credits run out.

## Tips
- Put frequent questions in detail; the clearer they are, the more accurate the replies.
- Review the messages the agent wrote (they are marked) from time to time.

## Troubleshooting
- **The agent is silent:** check that it is on, no handoff is active, credits remain, and the customer wrote within the last 24 hours.
- **131047:** the agent does not reply after 24 hours; use a template.
- **A wrong reply:** edit the knowledge or persona, and take the conversation over.

# Campaigns and opt-out

A campaign is a marketing message sent with an approved template to a group of your customers. The customer must have agreed to receive messages from you.

## What you need before you start
- A connected number and an approved **marketing** template ([Templates](04-templates-and-the-24-hour-window.md)).
- Contacts who **opted in**, with the source of their consent recorded.
- Enough balance if you use the shared number ([Wallet](09-wallet-top-ups-and-refunds.md)). On your own number, Meta bills your card directly.

## Steps
1. **Contacts:** upload a CSV (up to 10 MB) with phone, name and tags. We normalize phone formats, remove duplicates and tell you which rows were rejected.
2. **Segment:** choose a group (for example a tag, or customers who wrote recently). People who opted out are always removed.
3. Choose the **template** and fill in the variables.
4. Check the **estimated cost** before confirming.
5. Send now or **schedule** a time.
6. Follow progress on the Campaigns screen. You can pause, resume or cancel.

## Delete a draft
A campaign that is still a draft (not sent and not scheduled) can be deleted: open it and press **Delete draft**. Store owner only. A campaign in any other state cannot be deleted (cancel it if it has not finished); the answer is "bad state".

## Consent when you import
- On the **Contacts** screen, under the file upload, there is a box: "These customers agreed to receive offers from me on WhatsApp, and I can prove it."
- Tick it only if you really have their consent. Left unticked, the contacts are added but **will not receive campaigns** until they agree.
- An import never undoes a customer's opt-out and never overwrites consent already on record.
- Before you send, the screen shows how many customers the campaign reaches, and how many it skips and why (opted out, or no consent on record).

## Tracked links
- Choose "Tracked link" for a template variable and each customer gets their own link to the page you set (it must start with https).
- The Campaigns screen shows how many customers opened the link and how many opens there were. WhatsApp's automatic link previews are not counted.

## Who can do what
- Only the store owner can create and send a campaign, or resume a paused one, because it spends money.
- Anyone on the team can pause or cancel a campaign.

## Opt-out
- If a customer writes **STOP**, **STOP ALL**, **UNSUBSCRIBE**, **CANCEL**, **OPTOUT**, **إلغاء**, **وقف**, **توقف**, **ايقاف** or **بطل**, or taps a button that says Stop, Stop all, Stop promotions or Unsubscribe, marketing to them stops immediately and the choice is recorded. Only the whole message counts: "please cancel my order" is an order question and does not opt anyone out. A button that just says "Cancel" is never an opt-out, so you can use it freely in your own templates (for example "cancel appointment").
- Your uploaded CSV is deleted from our storage as soon as the import ends (a 7-day expiry backs this up). If you erase a customer while an import is still running, that import is stopped and its file deleted; upload it again without that customer.
- Opting out on Wh

atsApp is also recorded at your store, so the customer is not marketed to there either.
- Order and service messages (like an order confirmation) are not affected, because they are not marketing.
- Do not add someone who opted out again without new consent from them.

## Limits
- **Tier limit:** your number has a daily limit on how many new customers you can start conversations with (250 to begin with, rising after verification and with good message quality). Meta sets it. Anything over waits until the next day automatically.
- **Balance:** if the balance runs out mid-campaign on the shared number, marketing stops and the campaign pauses with a clear reason.
- **Number quality:** if many customers report or block your messages, quality drops and the limit may go down.

## Error 131049 (frequency cap), in plain words
Sometimes Meta does not deliver a marketing message to a particular customer, so that person is not flooded with marketing from many businesses. This error does **not** mean your number or template has a problem, and it does not mean the customer blocked you. We retry after 24 hours, twice, and if it still does not deliver we leave it. Do not resend the same message by hand.

## Tips
- Send to people who are genuinely interested; fewer, sharper messages protect your quality.
- Include something useful, not a generic offer.

t before it is confirmed. The request shows **under review**, then **confirmed** (the package starts or the balance grows by the amount) or **rejected** with the reason (make a new request with the right receipt).

**Cancel a yearly package and ask for a refund.** With a yearly package running, **Wallet > Cancel the yearly package** shows what you would get back: the months not started, their value, any wallet debt settled first, and the refund to your card. These are the same figures our team uses to carry it out. Press **Request cancellation and refund**, check the figures and press **Yes, send the request**. This only files a request and **no money moves**: our team reviews it, cancels the package at the end of the month you are in and sends any card refund by hand. The month you are in is never refunded, so in the last month there is nothing to request. If your wallet owes money, the debt is settled first; if it covers the whole refund, nothing goes back to your card. One request at a time. If th

e figures changed between the preview and your confirmation (a new month began, or the debt changed), it is refused and you look again. If a renewal is queued after your package, this card is not offered; contact our team.

*Refunding a yearly package:* we can refund the **whole months you have not started**, at the yearly price divided by 12 (rounded down). The month you are in is never refunded, so a refund in the last month is nothing. If your wallet is in debt, the debt is settled first out of the refund. A partial refund shortens the yearly period by the months refunded (all refunds add up, and the end date can only move earlier). A month that starts on the 31st can begin on the 3rd of the following month and on the 31st after that (a short month overflows), so two monthly credit grants can fall in the same calendar month; each month is still granted once.

*Notes:* if your store plan already includes WhatsApp, you get the included package automatically. A package you bought is never replaced by a change in the store plan while it is running. Support can also assign a package to your account.

## Overdraft
- There is an overdraft limit of **50 EGP** for urgent messages (service replies inside the window, and verification codes).
- **Marketing messages stop at zero** and never go below zero.
- On the shared number, transactional messages (like an order confirmation) that cannot be paid wait up to 48 hours to be sent after a top-up; after that they fail with "insufficient balance" and we notify you.

## Statement
From **Wallet > Statement** choose a month to see every entry (top-up, message, credits, refund) with totals by category, and download it as CSV. Figures are shown as recorded at the time of the entry.

## Refunds
*(Subject to the final terms of service.)*
- The wallet balance is refundable for **12 months** after cancellation, after any debt is settled.
- Refunds go to the original payment method through Kashier; otherwise by bank transfer or InstaPay after an identity check.
- **The minimum refund is 50 EGP.**
- **Not refundable:** card fees already paid, AI credits that came with the package, the current package period (it keeps working until the period ends), and purchased AI credits that were used or are older than 14 days.
- Financial records are kept even after you cancel or ask for data deletion, as the law requires.

To request one, open **Wallet** and press **Request a refund**, enter the amount (at least 50 EGP and no more than your available balance) and an optional note, then send it. It appears under **Your requests** and the Ebda AI Studio team reviews it and gets back to you. You can ask after your plan ends or is cancelled, within 12 months. For help, write to ahlan@ebda.app. For a yearly package, the whole months left after the current one are refundable at the package's monthly price (the yearly price ÷ 12), up to what you paid for that year; the current month is not refunded.

## Troubleshooting
- **I paid but the balance did not grow:** wait a few minutes. If it persists, email the transaction number to ahlan@ebda.app.
- **A campaign stopped with "insufficient balance":** top up and resume the campaign.
- **I was charged for a message that did not arrive:** we only charge messages Meta counts as billable.

---
Last checked: 2026-11-14. Refunds and fees are subject to the final terms of service. Meta's rules change.

# Meta fees, explained simply

Meta charges for messages by **message type**, not by word count. Prices differ by the country you send to and change from time to time.

## Message categories
- **Marketing:** offers and campaigns. The most expensive.
- **Utility:** order confirmation, shipping, COD confirmation.
- **Authentication:** verification codes.
- **Service:** your reply to a customer's message within the 24-hour window. Meta treats these specially (part of them may be free); check Meta's page for current details.

## Who pays Meta?
| Your case | Who pays | How you see the cost |
|---|---|---|
| **Your own number** | **Meta bills your own card directly** | We show Meta's cost for information, without deducting from the wallet |
| **The shared number** | **The wallet**, at Meta's price | Every entry in the statement |

**Your own number shows "not ready yet"?** That means nobody has said who pays Meta for it, so sending from it is not ready. The owner opens **Wallet > Who pays WhatsApp?**, presses **Let Meta bill my card** on that number and then **Yes, confirm**. From then on Meta charges the card on your Meta account, and the wallet does not pay for that number (make sure a card is added to your Meta account first). Only the card is offered to you: the shared number's line is the platform's and only our team changes it, and a number our team put on that line is changed by us too.

Ebda AI Studio adds no margin to Meta's fees right now (**0%**). This may change, with notice first.

## How it is calculated
- The cost is counted when the message is **delivered** and Meta considers it billable, not when you send it.
- If the message fails or Meta does not charge for it, nothing is deducted.
- The category Meta charges under is the one that counts, even if it differs from what we expected.
- Meta's prices are in US dollars, so they are converted to pounds at a set exchange rate.

## To keep costs down
- Reply quickly inside the 24-hour window (service replies cost less).
- Send marketing only to interested customers.
- Pick the right template category.

## Troubleshooting
- **I was charged for a message that did not arrive:** open the statement, check the entry, and send us the message ID.
- **The cost differs from the estimate:** the estimate is approximate; the actual cost follows the category at delivery.

Current prices and the country list: see the WhatsApp Business pricing page on Meta's website.

---

docs.title: Service menu, opening hours and your location

chunks.text:
# Service menu, opening hours and your location

Your customers get quick answers from the bot without waiting for you: a menu of your common questions, an automatic reply when you are closed, and your store's location on a tap.

## What you need before you start
- A connected number ([guide 2](02-connect-your-own-number.md)).
- The owner account. Staff can see these settings but cannot change them.

## The service menu
1. Open **Bot** in the side rail, then **Service menu**.
2. Press **Add a question**. Give it a short name (up to 24 characters) and an answer (up to 1024 characters), in Arabic and in English. Customers see the language they write in.
3. Use **Move up** and **Move down** to order the questions, and **Remove** to delete one. You can add up to 8.
4. Turn on **Turn on the service menu** and save.

The customer sees the menu when they say hello, type "menu", or write something the bot has no ready answer for. The menu also offers **Order now** (when your store is linked), **Our location** (when you set one) and **Talk to a person**. Tapping a question sends its answer and nothing else. **Talk to a person** tags the chat for your team and the bot stays quiet ([guide 7](07-ai-agent.md), Handoff to staff).

WhatsApp shows at most 10 choices in a list. The fixed choices always show, so with a location and a linked store only 7 of your questions fit.

If the menu is off or has no questions, nothing changes: the bot behaves as before.

## Opening hours and the away message
1. In **Opening hours**, turn the switch on.
2. For each day add one or two periods (for example 10:00 to 18:00 and 20:00 to 23:00). A day with no period is closed all day.
3. A period that closes at a time earlier than it opens runs past midnight (for example 22:00 to 02:00 belongs to the day it opened).
4. Write the **away message** in Arabic and in English (up to 1024 characters each).
5. Choose whether the bot and the AI agent **keep taking orders while you are closed**.

Times are Cairo time, and the switch between summer and winter time is handled for you.

When a customer writes while you are closed, they get the away message **once** for that closed period, not on every message. If you let the bot keep taking orders, it carries on after the away message. If you switch that off, the away message replaces the bot and the agent, and the customer gets nothing more until you open. When a team member has taken over a chat, the away message stays out of the way.

## Your location
1. In **Store location**, fill the place name, the address, the latitude and the longitude. A link under the fields opens the map so you can check the pin.
2. Save.

The customer gets your location on WhatsApp, followed by a map link, when they pick **Our location** or write "address", "location" or "فين". If you leave the location empty, those words are treated like any other message. **Clear the location** removes it.

## Your WhatsApp catalog
If you do not have a catalog on Meta yet, the **WhatsApp catalog** box at the top of the Bot screen has a **Create my WhatsApp catalog** button (store owner only). It creates the catalog in your Meta business, connects it to your WhatsApp number and starts filling it with your store products within a few minutes. Afterwards the box shows the catalog ID and the time of the last sync.
- If it says Meta needs catalog access, or that your business could not be identified, open **WhatsApp number**, connect your number again and approve every permission Meta asks for, including the catalog one. Then press the button again.
- If it says Meta is not answering, wait a little and press the button again. It never creates a second catalog.
- If you already have a catalog on Me
ta connected to this number, you do not need the button.

## Bot results
At the top of the Bot screen, **Bot results** shows how many customers reached each step of ordering on WhatsApp: **started a chat, saw the products, added to cart, went to checkout, placed the order**. Next to each step you see the share of customers who went on from the step before, so you can see where people drop off. Pick the last 7, 30 or 90 days. Below the steps, **opened the menu** and **asked for a person** are counted on their own.
- Each customer is counted **once per step per day**, however many messages they send. A customer who comes back on another day counts on each day.
- The numbers are counts only. We do not keep anyone's phone number, name or messages for this, and a customer cannot be traced from them. If a customer asks to be erased, their entry for the

current day is deleted too.
- Today's numbers are live; earlier days are final. Nobody can edit these numbers; owner and staff can read them.
- "No conversations yet" means no customer talked to the bot in that period. If you see a loading error instead, press **Try again**.

## Important notes
- The bot replies only inside the 24-hour window ([guide 4](04-templates-and-the-24-hour-window.md)). All of this is a reply to a message the customer just sent, never marketing.
- The text you write is checked against WhatsApp's length limits when you save. Fields marked in red must be fixed first.
- Test from your own phone after saving.

---
Last checked: 2026-11-14. Meta's rules change; if the Meta screen in front of you differs from this guide, follow what you see.

# Delete your Ebda Chat workspace

The store owner can ask us to delete the workspace and everything in it. Support can also do it at your request.

## What happens
1. You confirm the request. Nothing is deleted yet: there is a **14-day waiting period** and you can cancel any time before it ends.
2. After 14 days we stop all sending, disconnect your numbers and delete your conversations, contacts, media, uploaded files, campaigns, AI settings and backups.
3. Records of payments and refunds are kept as the law requires, **without your store's name**.

## Before you ask
- If your wallet still has a balance, either request your refund first ([Wallet](09-wallet-top-ups-and-refunds.md)) or agree in the request that the balance is given up.
- A refund or payment still being processed delays the deletion until it finishes, however long ago it was started.
- While a deletion is waiting, top-ups and package purchases are paused. If you want to buy something, cancel the deletion first and ask again later.
- If your balance grows during the 14 days (for example a payment that was still in progress arrives), we do not delete until you or our team agrees to the new amount, or you cancel. We will write to you at ahlan@ebda.app.
- Deleting does not cancel anything at Meta; remove your number from your Meta account yourself if you no longer want it th
ere.

## Who can do what
Only the store owner can ask or cancel. Staff cannot. If our team started the deletion at your request, only our team can cancel it: write to ahlan@ebda.app.

Last checked: 2026-10-27.

chunks.text:
# Your customers' data: retention, download, rename, merge

All of this is on the **Contacts** screen.

## How long messages are kept
Under "How long messages are kept" the store owner picks the period: 90 days, 6 months, one year, **two years (the default)**, 3, 5 or 10 years. Messages older than the period are deleted automatically, with their pictures and files. Your notes, tags, orders and payment records are not deleted. Deleting cannot be undone, so lengthen the period first if you may need old chats for a dispute.

## Download one customer's data
Pick the customer in the list and choose **Download the customer's data** (store owner only). You get a JSON file with their messages, your notes, their tags and orders. Use it when a customer asks what you hold about them. Every download is recorded in the action log.

## Rename a customer
Pick the customer, type the name, **Save the name**. The name you set stays: WhatsApp's profile name no longer replaces it.

## Merge two numbers
When one person writes from a new number, pick the old one, type the new number and choose **Merge the two customers** (store owner only). Messages, notes and tags move to the new number and the old one disappears from the list. **It cannot be undone.** If either number asked to stop messages, both are stopped.

## Erase a customer
When a customer asks you to delete their data, pick them, read the warning, type the last 4 digits of their number and choose **Erase customer permanently** (store owner only). Their messages and data are removed from this workspace. **It cannot be undone.** Money and order records stay as they are. Ebda AI Studio staff are not needed; they only act on a written request that came to them directly.

chunks.text:
# Your team and seats in Ebda Chat

Your package says how many people can work in Ebda Chat, **you included**: Starter and Store-included 2, Growth 5, Pro 15. You decide who gets the seats.

## How it works
1. Add the person as staff on your store (in Ebda Store). Adding them there does not give them access to WhatsApp yet.
2. Open **Team** in Ebda Chat (store owner only) and press **Give a seat** next to their name.
3. They can now open the inbox. Without a seat they see a page that tells them to ask you.

You always have your place and never need a seat. The seat count on the Team page, "2 of 5 seats", counts you.

## When the seats run out
If the package has no seat left, **Give a seat** answers that the package allows N people. Remove another person's seat, or upgrade your package from the Wallet, and try again.

## Removing someone
- **Remove seat** stops their access to WhatsApp at once, and frees the seat. They stay on your store.
- If you remove a person from your store, or suspend them, their WhatsApp access stops at once as well and their seat is freed the next time you open the Team page. If you bring them back, give them a seat again.

## If you move to a smaller package (or the plan ends)
Nothing is deleted. The people who were given seats first keep working, up to the new limit. The others are paused (the Team page says so) until you remove a seat or upgrade. When your plan is not in effect, only you can work, as for every other feature.

## Good to know
- Only the store owner sees the Team page and can give or remove seats. Staff cannot.
- Names only: we never show your team's emails or phone numbers on this page.
- If we cannot reach your store's team list for a moment, the page says so and changes nothing. Try again shortly.

Last checked: 2026-10-29.

# Your products on WhatsApp

Your Ebda Store products appear inside WhatsApp as a shop: a **shop button** on your business profile, **product cards** that the AI agent sends in the chat, and a **cart** the customer sends you, which becomes a real order in your store.

## What you need before you start
- A connected number ([guide 2](02-connect-your-own-number.md)) and your store linked.
- A WhatsApp catalog. Press **Create my WhatsApp catalog** under **Bot** in the side rail; we connect it to your number and fill it with your products.
- The owner account for the switches. Staff can see the status.

## What happens by itself
- Every product, price, stock level, picture and delete in your store reaches the catalog within minutes. A full check runs every night and fixes anything that was missed.
- Products with options (size, colour) appear as one item per option, grouped under the product.
- WhatsApp needs a **picture** for every product (a secure https link). A product without one is left out and listed under **Products not shown on WhatsApp** with the reason. Add the picture in your store and it appears at the next update, or press **Update the catalog now**.
- The **shop button** and the **cart** are switched on for you. You can turn either off on the same screen. **Turn them off here, not in WhatsApp Manager or the Business app**: a change made only in Meta is put back at the next
check (within two days), because Ebda Chat keeps your choice from this screen.

## In the chat
When a customer asks to see products, the AI agent sends cards with the picture, name and price (several products arrive as one list). The customer taps a product, adds it to the cart and sends the cart. We read every line again from your store (price, stock, whether it still exists), tell the customer about anything sold out or changed, ask how they want to pay and where to deliver, and create the order in your store. One cart message becomes one order, even if WhatsApp delivers it twice.

If the catalog is not connected or a product is not in it yet, the agent answers in text with the product link instead.

## Use only one source
Ebda Chat is the only thing that should write to the catalog linked to WhatsApp. **Do not also connect your Google product feed link to this catalog in Meta**: every product would appear twice. If you need a catalog for ads, make a separate one.

## If something looks wrong
- **Meta needs catalog access**: reconnect your number from **WhatsApp number** and approve the catalog permission, then press **Update the catalog now**.
- **The update is delayed**: we retry on our own. If it lasts more than a day, contact us.
- **A product is not shown**: check the reason under **Products not shown on WhatsApp**.

docs.title: Write a template and send it to Meta

chunks.text:
# Write a template and send it to Meta

A template is a message Meta approves before you can send it to a customer outside the 24-hour window. You write it on the **Templates** page of Ebda Chat and it is created on your own WhatsApp account.

## Steps
1. Open **Templates** and choose **New template**.
2. **What is it for?** Pick one of three cards: a service message about an order (confirmation, shipping, status), a marketing message (offers), or a verification code. Marketing messages need the customer's opt-in and are billed at the marketing price.
3. **Language and title.** Pick the language. The title is only for you; customers never see it. The technical name Meta uses is made for you and is under **Advanced settings**.
4. **Write the text.** Press **Add a variable** where the customer name or order number goes. A variable looks like {{1}}. Write an example value for every variable: Meta needs the examples to review the template.
5. **Optional parts.** A header, a footer, and buttons (quick replies, a link, a call button,

a copy-code button).
6. **Fix what the page tells you.** The page checks Meta's rules while you type, beside the field. Errors stop the send button. A warning (for example wording that looks like an offer inside a service message) you tick to confirm.
7. **Review and send to Meta.** You see the message as the customer will see it. **A template sent to Meta cannot be taken back.** You can edit or delete it later, but not recall the submission. Confirm to send.
8. Meta reviews it, up to 24 hours. The status on the page changes by itself.

## Limits Meta sets (the page applies them for you)
- Text: up to 1024 characters. Variables are numbered {{1}}, {{2}} in order with no gaps, and the text cannot start or end with a variable.
- Header: text only for now, up to 60 characters, at most one variable. Footer: up to 60 characters, no variables.
- Buttons: up to 10 in total; up to 2 link buttons and 1 call button; each label up to 25 characters. Quick replies and the other buttons must be grouped, not mixed.
- Verification codes: the wording is fixed by Meta, no links and no emojis, and the code is valid for 1 to 90 minutes.
- Meta allows 100 template submissions per hour and 250 templates on an unverified business (6,000 verified).

## Which type?
- **Service message:** about an order the customer made. It must not be promotional.
- **Marketing message:** anything with an offer or a discount. If you file an offer as a service message, Meta changes it to marketing and tells you after you send: the customer must have agreed to marketing, each message costs more, and it counts toward your campaigns.
- **Verification code:** a one-time code.

## If you are on the shared number
You cannot create templates yourself. Open **Templates**, use the ready-made ones, or press **Request a service template** and the team creates it for you. Marketing messages need your own number.

---
Last checked: 2026-11-14. Meta's rules change; if the Meta screen in front of you differs from this guide, follow what you see.

# Template review and rejections

Meta reviews every template, usually within minutes and up to 24 hours. This guide explains the statuses, how to read a rejection, and how to edit or delete a template.

## The statuses
- **Live:** approved. You can use it.
- **In Meta review:** sent and waiting. Up to 24 hours. After an hour Ebda Chat asks Meta by itself; you can also press **Sync with Meta**.
- **Rejected:** Meta did not approve it. See the reason on the template.
- **Paused:** Meta paused it for a while because customers reacted badly to it. Edit it and send it again.
- **Disabled:** Meta turned it off for good. It cannot be edited or deleted; create a new one with different text.
- **Being deleted:** the delete has not reached Meta yet.

## Reading a rejection
Open the template. You see the reason in plain words, and Meta's own code below it. The usual reasons:
- **Variables are formatted wrongly** (the most common). A variable must be written {{1}} with two braces each side, numbered in order from 1 with no gaps, with an example each, and the text cannot start or end with a variable.
- **Policy.** Prohibited commerce claims, sensitive data, or wording that reads like a scam or abuse. Rewrite it calmer and clearer.
- **Length or emojis.** Too long, too many emojis, or too many variables for the length of the text.
- **Duplicate.** Another template has the same text and footer. Change the text or delete the old one.
- **Wrong category.** A promotion filed as a service message. Choose marketing, or remove the offer.
If the code is one we do not know, you get the general advice and the code is shown so support can look at it.

## Edit and resubmit
Open the template and press **Edit and resubmit**. A rejected template keeps its **name** and can be edited as many times as you need; its type can be changed before approval. An **approved** template can be edited once every 24 hours and 10 times a month (Meta's rule), its type is locked, and Meta reviews it again after each edit. A template that is in review cannot be edited. The page shows when you can edit again.

## Delete
Open the template and press **Delete the template**. Every campaign that uses it must finish first, and a message still waiting to be sent counts too. Deleting removes one language only. The name of an approved template cannot be used again for 30 days after deleting it. A disabled template cannot be deleted.

## Meta tells us by itself
As soon as Meta decides (approves, rejects, pauses or disables a template) it sends us the status and the reason, and the app updates the template without you doing anything. A review takes from minutes to about a day. You see the reason when you open the template.

## When Meta changes the type
If Meta decides a "service" template is really marketing, it changes the category. From then on the customer must have agreed to marketing, each message costs more, and it counts toward your campaigns. The Templates page shows the type Meta chose, never the one you asked for.

---

chunks.text:
# Sign in, change the language and sign out

You open Ebda Chat with the same Ebda AI Studio account you use for Ebda Store. There is no separate password for Ebda Chat, and the page itself never asks you for one.

## Who can sign in
The store owner and any team member who has been given a seat. The difference between the roles is in the [team and seats guide](14-team-members-and-seats.md). If you sign in and find nowhere to work, you have no seat yet: the owner needs to give you one.

## Sign in
1. Open wa.ebda.app.
2. Press **Sign in**.
3. Use your Ebda AI Studio account (the same one as Ebda Store).
4. You land in the **Conversations** of your store.

## Change the language
At the top of the conversation list there is a language button, labelled with the other language (**English** or **العربية**). Press it and the whole screen switches; the direction flips between right-to-left and left-to-right. Arabic is the default. Phone numbers and links always stay left-to-right, even inside Arabic text.

## Sign out
Press **Sign out** at the bottom of the side rail. What the app keeps in your browser is cleared. On a device that is not yours, also sign out of your account at the sign-in provider so the next person cannot get in with it (the page reminds you).

## If you cannot get in
- **"We could not sign you in"** with a reason underneath: the sign-in provider refused or cancelled the request, the request was already used, or the answer did not match the request. In every case press **Try signing in again** and start from the beginning; do not reopen an old sign-in link.
- **"We could not reach the sign-in service right now":** the service is not answering. Wait a moment and press **Try again**.
- **You were signed out suddenly and saving says "session revoked":** your session was closed. Sign in again.
- **The page says sign-in is not configured:** open Ebda Chat from your own portal, or ask whoever set the app up for you.
- On a phone the side rail becomes a navigation menu, and the orders panel opens as a sheet from below.

If it still does not work, send ahlan@ebda.app the message you see on screen.

---

docs.title: Find a conversation fast: filters and search

chunks.text:
# Find a conversation fast: filters and search

The **Conversations** screen lists every customer who wrote to you. The owner and the team both see it.

## Filters
Four buttons sit above the list: **All**, **Unread**, **Mine** and **Unassigned**.
- **Unread:** conversations with messages you have not opened. The total shows next to the title.
- **Mine:** conversations assigned to you (by taking over, or by assignment).
- **Unassigned:** conversations nobody has taken.

A conversation can carry marks: a small dot on the avatar while a cash-on-delivery order waits for the customer's answer ([COD guide](05-cod-confirmations.md)), and **Needs your team** when the customer asked for a person ([AI agent guide](07-ai-agent.md)). The number on the right is the number of unread messages.

## Search
Type in the search box: a customer name, a number or a word from a message. Results appear as you type and your word is highlighted. Move through the results with the up and down arrows, press Enter to open the one you are on, and Esc to clear the search.
- If you see "Search is not working right now, try again", try again in a moment.
- Messages older than your retention period are deleted and cannot be found. You choose the period in the [customer data guide](13-your-customers-data.md).

## Marking as read
A conversation is marked read the moment you open it, and the unread counter drops. There is no separate "mark as read" button, and no way to mark a chat unread again.

## If the list does not update
The list updates by itself ([reading a conversation and live updates](20-read-a-conversation-and-live-updates.md)). If your connection drops you see "You are offline".

---
Last checked: 2026-11-14.

docs.title: Reading a conversation and live updates

chunks.text: # Reading a conversation and live updates

## Open a conversation
Press the customer's name in **Conversations**. Messages are in date order with a separator for each day, and times are Cairo time. Under your own messages you see the status: sent, delivered, read or failed ([failed messages guide](22-failed-messages-and-sending-limits.md)). At the top of the chat you see the time left in the 24-hour window ([templates and the 24-hour window](04-templates-and-the-24-hour-window.md)).

- **Long message:** a message over 1 KB is shown shortened with **Read the full message** under it.
- **Image, file or voice note:** it loads with your sign-in when you open the chat. If it says "File unavailable", Meta no longer provides it (it was deleted there or failed to load). Ask the customer to send it again.
- **Voice note:** with the AI agent on, the text appears under it ([AI agent guide](07-ai-agent.md)).
- **Old messages:** messages past your retention period are deleted. History that comes from the WhatsApp Business app shows here, but it never opens the 24-hour window.

## New messages
You never need to refresh. The app stays connected, so a new message or a status change appears on its own. If the connection drops you see "You are offline", and messages you typed send as soon as the connection is back. Sometimes the app reloads the list by itself after missing many updates; that is normal.

## If messages do not show
1. Check your connection. If "You are offline" shows, wait until it clears.
2. Close the page and open it again.
3. If a customer says they wrote and you cannot see it, search by their name or number ([search guide](19-find-your-conversations.md)); they may have written from another number.

---

docs.title: Send a picture or a file to a customer

chunks.text: # Send a picture or a file to a customer

## Steps
1. Open the conversation. The 24-hour window must be open (the customer wrote less than 24 hours ago); otherwise the paperclip is disabled.
2. Press the paperclip (**Attach a file**).
3. Pick the file from your device. It is prepared and sent to the customer.

## Types and sizes WhatsApp allows
| Type | Largest size |
|---|---|
| JPG or PNG image | 5 MB |
| MP4 video | 16 MB |
| OGG audio with the Opus codec | 16 MB |
| PDF document | 50 MB |

Any other type is refused as "unsupported". The app checks the file itself, not its name, so renaming a file to get it through does not work. HEIC pictures and .mov videos must be converted to a normal JPG or MP4 first.

## When the 24 hours have passed
WhatsApp allows neither files nor free text outside the window (error 131047). The only way is a template approved by Meta ([templates guide](04-templates-and-the-24-hour-window.md)). The composer then shows **Choose a template**.

## If the file did not go
- **The file is over the limit in the table:** make it smaller or send it as another type.
- **The message is marked failed:** press **Try again** ([failed messages guide](22-failed-messages-and-sending-limits.md)).

---
Last checked: 2026-11-14.

docs.title: A message failed or is slow: why, and what to do

chunks.text: # A message failed or is slow: why, and what to do

## A message marked "failed"
Under a failed message you see a warning mark and a **Try again** button. Press it and the message is sent again.

Temporary errors (such as a connection problem at Meta) are retried by the app by itself before a message is marked failed. So a message that failed after that usually will not be fixed by retrying right away. These are the codes Meta returns most often; support will ask for the code if you contact us:
- **131026:** the number is not on WhatsApp, or the customer blocked you. Nothing to do except reach them another way.
- **131047:** more than 24 hours since the customer last wrote. Send an approved template ([templates guide](04-templates-and-the-24-hour-window.md)).
- **131049:** Meta limited marketing messages to this customer because they received many. Wait, or send a service message if they reply ([campaigns guide](08-campaigns-and-opt-out.md)).
- **131051:** the message type is not s

upported ([sending files guide](21-send-files-in-chat.md)).
- **132001:** the template does not exist at Meta. Pick another one in **Templates**.
- **2494051:** there is no payment method on your Meta account. Add one using the [Meta fees guide](10-meta-fees-explained.md).

The app does not translate the code into a reason next to each message, so if the code is not in this list send it to ahlan@ebda.app.

## Messages that are slow
WhatsApp puts two limits on a number:
1. **How many new conversations you can start per day** (50, 250, 1,000, 10,000, 100,000 or unlimited; it rises as your business is verified and your number keeps good quality). When you reach it, the extra new conversations wait until the next day and go out by themselves. Your current limit shows under **WhatsApp number**.
2. **Sending speed on the number.** If you send a lot at once (such as a big campaign) messages queue up and go out at the speed Meta allows.

In both cases there is nothing for you to do. Messages are not lost. **Try again** will not speed them up.

---
Last checked: 2026-11-14.

# Notes, tags and quick replies: what exists today

This guide says exactly what you can do from the screen right now and what has no screen yet. Nothing here describes something that does not exist.

## Quick replies
Above the message box in a conversation there are four ready replies (a greeting, "your order is confirmed", "could you send your full address", "thank you"). Press one and its text drops into the box, where you can edit it before sending. **These replies are fixed:** there is nowhere to add your own. They disappear when the 24-hour window closes.

If you want a repeated answer in your own words, the AI agent uses the questions and answers you write ([AI agent guide](07-ai-agent.md)), and the service menu answers common questions ([service menu guide](11-service-menu-hours-and-location.md)).

## Tags
- **Customer tags:** shown on each customer under **Contacts**. You can set them in bulk with a tags column when you import a CSV ([customer data guide](13-your-customers-data.md)), and pick them as a campaign audience ([campaigns guide](08-campaigns-and-opt-out.md)). **There is no button to edit one customer's tag from the screen.**
- **Conversation tags:** the system adds two by itself and they show in the list: the dot while a cash-on-delivery order waits for an answer, and **Needs your team** when the customer asked for a person. There is no button to add or remove a conversation tag.

## Internal notes
Internal notes on a conversation exist as a feature, but **Ebda Chat has no screen for them today**, so there is nowhere to type one. Any existing notes (if written from a connected system) are included when you download or erase a customer's data ([customer data guide](13-your-customers-data.md)).

If you need one of these on the screen, tell us at ahlan@ebda.app.

---
Last checked: 2026-11-14.

# The weekly summary

A simple picture of your store's last week on WhatsApp, inside Ebda Chat.

## Where to find it
Open **Wallet**. You will find a card called **This week**, with the period above it (from a date to a date). It shows:
- Customers who wrote
- Messages received
- Messages sent
- Messages that failed
- Assistant replies
- Chats handed to your team
- Spent on WhatsApp messages
- Wallet balance

If your wallet or your AI credits are running low you also see a warning: top up so messages do not stop ([wallet guide](09-wallet-top-ups-and-refunds.md)).

## Switch it on or off
Press **Switch the weekly summary off** if you do not want it. The card then says it is off, and you can press **Switch the weekly summary on** any time. The owner and the team can both see it.

## Notes
- It is counts only: no customer name, number or message text.
- It appears inside the app only. It is not sent by e-mail or WhatsApp.
- If you see "We could not load the weekly summary right now", open the page again in a while.

---

# Alerts: how you find out about a problem

Ebda Chat tells you inside the app only. **There is no e-mail and no phone push, and no screen to choose your alerts.** So you need to open the app to see them.

## The alerts you will see
- **Package renewal:** a week before your package ends, a bar appears above the conversation list: "Your package ends (date). Renew it so campaigns do not stop", with an **Open the wallet** button ([wallet guide](09-wallet-top-ups-and-refunds.md)).
- **Wallet balance is low**, or **you owe a debt:** the same bar, with the amount when it is a debt.
- **An InstaPay payment was rejected:** the reason shows in the same bar ([wallet guide](09-wallet-top-ups-and-refunds.md), Pay with InstaPay).
- **The weekly summary** in the Wallet ([weekly summary guide](24-weekly-summary.md)).
- **Number quality and sending limit:** shown on the **WhatsApp number** page under the number ([connect your number guide](02-connect-your-own-number.md)).
- **A conversation that needs your
team:** it is marked **Needs your team** in the list and inside the chat. No message is sent to your phone, so look at the list from time to time ([AI agent guide](07-ai-agent.md)).

## The "someone removed the app from Facebook" notice
If one of the people who connected your number to WhatsApp removed the app from Facebook, you see a notice on the **WhatsApp number** page. **Nothing was disconnected and your numbers still work.** You have two choices:
1. If that person should no longer be connected, disconnect the number from the same page.
2. If it does not matter, press **Keep numbers connected** and the notice goes away.
This button is for the store owner only.

---
Last checked: 2026-11-14.
# Verification codes on WhatsApp

## The idea
A verification code is the code your customer receives to confirm their number (for example while signing up at your store). By default it goes by **e-mail**. It can also go on WhatsApp from your own number. There is a separate thing too: the code you receive when you sign in to your Ebda AI Studio account is sent from a number that belongs to Ebda AI Studio itself, never from your store's number.

## Sending from your number: it must be switched on first
- The feature is **off by default**. There is no button for it in the app today, so if you want it, write to ahlan@ebda.app and we help you switch it on for your store.
- You need **your own number** connected ([connect your number guide](02-connect-your-own-number.md)). The shared number does not send codes.
- You need an **approved verification-code template** (otp_code). You write it in **Templates** and choose "A verification code" ([template writing guide](16-write-and-submit-a-template.md)). Meta fixes its wording and you only choose how long a code is valid.

## Limits
- Egypt (+20) only, by default.
- 5 codes to the same number every 10 minutes, and 30 codes for the store in that window. Beyond that it pauses for a while.
- The code itself is never logged, and it is stored masked.
- The fee for a code message follows Meta's fee for the verification category ([Meta fees guide](10-meta-fees-explained.md)).

## If the code does not arrive
One of these: the customer's number is not Egyptian, too many were sent in a short time, the feature is not on for your store, no number is connected, the code template is not approved, the wallet is empty ([wallet guide](09-wallet-top-ups-and-refunds.md)), or Meta refused the send. First confirm the template is approved and the number is connected, and check the wallet.

---
Last checked: 2026-11-14.

# Connect Ebda Chat to your systems: the API and agent connectors

This guide is for a store owner who has a developer or a system (such as Odoo). **Ebda Chat has no screen for either today**: a developer sets them up, and this guide gives the picture. Full technical detail is on the Ebda Chat developer pages (HTTP API, and Webhooks and connectors).

## 1. The API for your server
- Available on the **Pro** package (the API feature).
- It is not live for every store yet: it is switched on for your store before use. To ask for it, write to ahlan@ebda.app.
- Only the store owner creates an "API client" in the Ebda AI Studio account settings and picks its permissions (read conversations, send messages, read templates, read and change customer tags, read campaigns). Your server uses it to get a token, valid for 10 minutes, from accounts.ebda.app.
- The server follows new messages by polling for events; there is no permanent connection for this kind of token.
- Any route outside the token's permissions is refused (403). If you revoke the client in your account, it stops working within about 30 seconds.

## 2. Connect the AI agent to your system (a connector)
If you want the AI agent to answer from your system's data (bookings, for example), you connect it with a **webhook** or with **Odoo**:
- You describe up to 10 tools for the agent, each with up to 10 inputs.
- The address must be https on port 443, and calls are signed with HMAC so you can verify them on your side. The secret is written once and never shown again.
- There is a connector test, once every 5 seconds.
- A customer who asked to be erased or who stopped messages (STOP) never triggers a call.
- Internal or unsafe addresses are refused.
- Only the store owner can change connectors.

Read the [AI agent guide](07-ai-agent.md) first to understand what the agent can say.

---
Last checked: 2026-11-14.

## The legal pages
They are on the Ebda AI Studio site, in Arabic and English (the Arabic version prevails if they differ):
- **Terms of use:** ebda.app/legal/whatsapp-terms/
- **Privacy policy:** ebda.app/legal/whatsapp-privacy/
- **Data processing agreement:** ebda.app/legal/whatsapp-dpa/

There is no link to them inside the Ebda Chat app itself today, so save these addresses. Some clauses (such as refunds and VAT) are still under legal review, as the [wallet and refunds guide](09-wallet-top-ups-and-refunds.md) says.

## Your customers' data
- How long messages are kept, downloading a customer's data, erasing it: [customer data guide](13-your-customers-data.md).
- Deleting your whole store: [delete your workspace guide](12-delete-your-workspace.md).

## When someone removes the app from Facebook and asks for their data to be deleted
Meta sends us a signed deletion request. What happens:
1. We remove the number connections that person made with Ebda Chat.
2. The store owner sees a notice on **WhatsApp number** ([alerts guide](25-alerts-and-notices.md)). Nothing disconnects by itself.
3. Some requests end as "needs review". A person on our team finishes those by hand because they involve a legal decision. There is nothing for you to do.
4. The person can follow their request on a status page with the tracking code Meta gives them.

---

# Bot switches and sending speed

Three switches decide what Ebda Chat does for your customers automatically, and one panel shows how fast your messages go out. All of it is on the **Bot** screen.

## What you need before you start
- A connected number ([your own](02-connect-your-own-number.md) or [the shared number](03-use-the-shared-number.md)). Without a number the sending panel only says to connect one.
- The store owner account. Staff can see the switches and the sending panel but cannot change a switch.

## The three switches
Open **Bot**, then **Bot switches**. A switch you turn off takes effect straight away. A switch you turn **on** that sends messages to customers asks you to confirm first.

- **Ordering bot** (on by default). When it is on, customers can order from the chat. When you turn it off, customers cannot order from the chat; their messages still reach you and your team. Turning it on again needs no confirmation.
- **Order confirmation messages** (on by default). When your store receives a new order, the customer gets a confirmation on WhatsApp. It needs an approved order confirmation template ([Templates](04-templates-and-the-24-hour-window.md)). Turning it **on** asks you to confirm because customers will receive messages and each one is charged to your wallet. Turning it off needs no confirmation.
- **Store-login codes over WhatsApp** (off by default). The sign-in code for your store can reach the customer on WhatsApp instead of email; email stays the main way. It

needs your own number (not the shared one) and an approved verification-code template. Turning it **on** asks you to confirm because each code sent is charged to your wallet. Turning it off needs no confirmation.

When you press a switch that needs confirmation, a box appears under it with the reason. Choose **Yes, turn it on** to finish, or **No, leave it off**. The confirmation is valid for 5 minutes and works once. If it expires, press the switch again.

Every change is written to the action log with who changed which switch and to what.

## Sending speed and message limit
**Sending speed and message limit** shows:
- Your **limit for new conversations** per 24 hours. Meta sets it and raises it as your quality stays good.
- How many of those you **used in the last 24 hours**.
- Your **sending speed** in messages per second.
- How many messages are **waiting for their turn**. When you reach the limit, new messages wait for a free slot and go out by themselves, so you do not need to send them again. The panel then shows when the next slot frees up.

Staff can read this panel too.

## If something is off
- Customers say they get no order confirmation: check the switch is on and that the confirmation template is approved.
- The ordering bot does not answer: check **Ordering bot** is on.
- Messages are late: look at **waiting for their turn** and the limit above.

Last checked: 2026-11-14.

# The Ebda Chat assistant: ask how to do anything

The assistant answers your questions about Ebda Chat in plain language and shows you the screen you need. If you ask it to change something, it prepares the change as a preview and you press **Apply**.

## How to open it
1. Press the **Assistant** button in the side rail, or press `Ctrl` + `J` (`⌘` + `J` on a Mac).
2. Type your question in your own words, in Arabic, Franco-Arabic or English. For example: "How do I send a template to a customer?" or "Where is my balance?".
3. When the answer lives on a specific screen you get a **Show me where** link that takes you straight there.

## Where its answers come from
- The official help guides; it names the guide under each answer.
- Your own data: wallet balance, package, templates, campaigns, numbers. It reads them through the same screens you use, with exactly your permissions.
- When there is no confirmed answer it says so plainly and offers to connect you with the support team.

## Changes it prepares for you
- You say "tag Mona as vip", "turn off the ordering bot" or "make a segment of customers who ordered", and it shows a **preview** with the before and after.
- Nothing changes until you press **Apply**. After applying you have 24 hours to press **Undo** and everything goes back.
- If the item changed since the preview (you edited it by hand, for example) you get a new preview instead of an overwrite of your edit.
- Every change runs with your own permissions: if your role does not allow it (a staff member on an owner-only setting) it is refused and nothing changes.
- Changes that involve money, deletion, messages to your customers, more than 20 items or a price change, or that cannot be undone (like an internal note), need your explicit confirmation: a confirm

card shows the reason and you press **Yes, do it** yourself. Typing "yes" in the chat does nothing on its own, the card expires after 15 minutes, and if something changed since the card was made you get a new one.
- Campaigns: it prepares the campaign as a draft, and before sending or scheduling it shows how many people it reaches, the template with its parameters and the expected wallet cost. Messages sent to customers cannot be taken back.
- It finds a customer by the name you typed. If two customers share that name it does not guess; it asks you to be more specific.

## What it never does
- It never asks for a password, a verification code, a key or card details, and it does not accept them if you type them. You enter those on the secure screen only, and it shows you where.
- It never says it did something it did not do. A change happens only when you press **Apply**.
- It cannot see other accounts. It works on your store only.

## Privacy and limits
- Phone numbers, e-mails and card numbers are masked before any text is stored or sent to the model.
- Conversations are kept masked for 90 days and are deleted when you delete your workspace.
- The assistant is free up to 150 messages per store per day. When you reach the limit it tells you and you can continue the next day.

## If you do not see the assistant
It is switched on store by store, in stages. If the button is missing, it is not on for your account yet; it appears by itself when it is.
